positionsPendingApproval.description: position changes awaiting approval; empty when no approval is pending, and also when a pending approval does not change any position. Does not affect `totalFound`, which counts `content` only. A position with a pending change appears in both arrays — in `content` with its current values, and here with the change

id.description: `id` of the position in `content` this entry refers to; absent for `PENDING_NEW`, where no position exists yet. A position with a pending change therefore appears under the same `id` in both arrays — in `content` with its current values, and here with the change

positionId.description: customer-supplied position reference, as submitted with the change request

positionOpenDate.description: absent when the change request did not specify one. For `PENDING_NEW` this is the requested date — the created position's open date is set when the approval completes

status.description: `PENDING_NEW` — a new position is requested; no position exists yet and the fields carry the requested values. `PENDING_CHANGES` — an existing position is being changed; the fields carry the values that will apply **after** approval, so read `content` via `id` for the current ones. `PENDING_REMOVAL` — an existing position is queued for removal; the fields carry the position's current values, as there is no post-approval state to report
